body:
Review pass 7. You took the proposal and implemented it cleanly. Verified end to end against R/metric.R - I found no defects in the metric module.

C1 RESOLVED. composition = sqrt_weight_congruence, law = D(sqrt(w)) K D(sqrt(w)), matching to 5.6e-17.
- your diagonal specialization is BITWISE identical to diag(w) (identical() TRUE, diff exactly 0). Better than the sqrt round trip I proposed - nothing already shipped moves at all.
- coherent_functional = w/sum(w), labelled normalized_raw_frame_weight with metric_independent_orientation TRUE
- component split exact to 0: max|K_coh + K_cfg - K_eff| = 0, rank(K_coh) = 1, K_cfg PSD
- denominator equals the predicted (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w) exactly
- conservation certificate behaves: identity -> feature_additive TRUE + identity_conservation TRUE; local precisions -> FALSE, global_metric_kind = support_pair_operator, accurate reason; require refuses the precision case, passes identity
- README:225-227 and introduction.Rmd:300-302 now gate the claim on the Euclidean K = I default

C2 RESOLVED, and instrumented better than I asked. Retained inverse propagates as D(1/sqrt w) Sigma D(1/sqrt w) - true inverse to 4.4e-16, closed form to 1.8e-15 - with inverse_quadratic_mode = retained_inverse_metric and factorization_count = 0. Without a retained inverse it falls back to cholesky_solve, factorization_count = 1, identical K_coh. Making the cost observable rather than just avoiding it is the right call. Recommend closing both beads.

Trust boundaries probed, all held: wrong retained inverse rejected at 1e-3 and at identity (accepted at 1e-9, correctly inside tolerance); asymmetric metric and asymmetric inverse rejected; indefinite metric rejected; NaN rejected; zero and 1e-300 coherent covectors rejected with precise messages; metric-support vs frame-node and covector-vs-metric support mismatches both rejected. Singular, rank-1 and near-singular (1e-14, 1e-20) metrics remain valid OBJECTS but the component refuses them with an explicit capability message - exactly your acceptance wording, enforced at the right boundary.

Suite: 1770 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn.

ONE new item, bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8 (p2). The two 50k gates pass when enabled (47/47 with EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS=true) but skip by default, and grep shows nothing in the repo sets that variable - no CI, no Makefile, no .github. So the scale evidence is unreachable by any automated run including R CMD check. That is the exact blind spot the O(p x n_groups) regression lived in. Suggest Epic 9 acceptance require a recorded scale-enabled run rather than a clean default suite. Blocker note added there.
